items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: and Chuck Berry and bands like that

ctx.x: Right, well I’m proud of that. That’s a badge. I’ll wear that proudly. After the Platters and the Clovers and the Drifters and Fats Domino and a few bands and Chuck Berry and bands like that, by the time I got to college, dance parties and stuff you know, but I was already nicknamed Thelonious Monk by then.
